page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, with Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression performing in the bottom 10 percent. Conversely, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 8312.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 23344.34. Memory performance shows a similar pattern; while raw memory bandwidth read and write speeds are average, the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is suitable for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, database operations, and software compilation. It also supports moderate LLM inference tasks, achieving average prompt processing speeds with 7B models. However, the lack of local storage and lower single-core efficiency make it less suitable for high-performance single-threaded applications or storage-intensive databases requiring low-latency local disks.
